For a Claude web chat: this is the project as its repo records it. The repo
is the source of truth; where this brief and your own assumptions differ,
the brief wins.

## What it is

Maps the structure of Alberta's open data catalogues as a whole — Edmonton (data.edmonton.ca, Socrata) in depth; Calgary (Socrata) and the province (open.alberta.ca, CKAN) first as search sources and the what's-missing reference (scope widened 2026-11-16; rename to `alberta-open-data-landscape` pending) — dataset similarity, clusters, joinable fields, catalogue metrics and change over time — from catalogue metadata. It is **not** a per-dataset explorer; the City's own tools (311 Explorer, portal previews) cover that. Spec: `docs/SPEC_landscape.md`.

## Out of scope — don't recommend back

- **open.alberta.ca `publications`** (34,614 records, almost all PDF reports) — a document search, not a dataset catalogue; only the 3,021 `opendata` records are in scope for now. `docs/SPEC_landscape.md` §Data sources.
- **Per-dataset exploration tools** (row browsers, dashboards for a single dataset, a 311 Explorer clone) — the City already provides these; this project's unit of analysis is the catalogue. `docs/SPEC_landscape.md`.

## Where things live

- `TODO.md` — living backlog and **the source of truth for progress**
- `docs/DECISIONS.md` — append-only index of locked decisions: one row + pointer to the doc holding the full reasoning
- `docs/CHANGE_PIPELINE.md` — the path a change takes, in order: before the PR, the PR, merging, after the merge, and when to stop and ask
- `docs/TOKEN_EFFICIENCY.md` — context/token hygiene (what NOT to read raw, session-summary archiving) and disk use (scratch intermediates, `df -h /` before a big build)
- `docs/DATA_ISSUES.md` — register of defects in data we DON'T control: evidence, what it breaks here, and **whether the publisher has been told**
- `docs/ASSUMPTIONS.md` — index of the premises a published number rests on that no guard proves: status, rough size if wrong, pointer to the evidence
- `docs/AUDIT_LEDGER.md` — coverage map of executed audit runs
- `data/DATA.md` — data source details, column names, known quirks
- `docs/REMOTE_VM.md` — **read FIRST in a Claude Code web/remote VM session**: network-policy constraints, environment setup
- `docs/WEB_CACHE_BUSTING.md` — **read when the project first ships a web page**, or before touching the build step that stamps asset URLs
- `docs/CLAUDE_WEB.md` — **read before a Claude web research chat**: the generated brief (`scripts/make_brief.py`), claude.ai Project sync, the reply format
- `docs/COPIER.md` — **read before pulling template changes** (`copier update`) or starting a project from the template
- `session-summary/` — session handoff notes
- `docs/SPEC_landscape.md` — purpose, core questions, harvest pitfalls, milestones, open questions

## Reply format

End your reply with these fenced tables — one row per item, `-` for an empty
cell. They map onto the repo's own ledgers, so a row can be pasted, not
rewritten. Leave a table out if it has no rows.

```
TODO | why | source
```

```
DECISION | rationale | test that would protect it, or [unverifiable]
```

```
CLAIM-CHECK | claim this brief makes, or the repo seems to assume | evidence for or against
```

Don't recommend anything listed under "Out of scope" or already a locked
decision, unless you are arguing that it should be reopened — then say so in
the DECISION table.
